verdict.rationale: The evidence shows in-platform hooks: Storefront exposes add_action() hooks for inserting PHP, HTML or JavaScript into core templates, and the marketplace's hundreds of extensions show functionality can be added inside the store. However, the documented hooks are presentation/template-oriented, and webhooks only send outbound notifications to external URLs rather than running logic inside the platform. Missing for 10: documented backend hooks/filters for discounts, shipping rules and checkout validation; developer docs on writing custom extension logic; any serverless function runtime; hands-on corroboration.
